text:
Type: turquoise velvet cushion
Use: comfort and color on a sofa, an armchair or a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, glam, mid-century modern
Materials: soft cotton velvet with a subtle sheen
Colors: turquoise, soft teal blue

Feel: plush, luxurious, fresh, cozy
Goes with: grey or navy sofas, brass accents, dark wood, emerald and mustard tones; glam, mid-century or contemporary living rooms
